Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: Relied on an auto-generated DuckDuckGo “Search Assist” snippet stating Michael Thornhill was born in London, England without verifying via authoritative sources (e.g., Wikipedia page or reputable obituaries). This likely conflated individuals and propagated an incorrect birthplace; subsequent searches were circular and failed to resolve the discrepancy, leading away from the correct answer (Sydney, Australia).
